name: Warden
text:
Decision: We should run a full network scan for open ports and services on every new system we deploy, before it touches production.

Reason: A fresh system might have forgotten services running or default credentials left open—this is the easiest time to catch it. It’s better to fail fast here than to risk a breach later when the system is live.

Trade-off: This adds a small delay to deployment, but that’s worth it to avoid the much larger cost of a security incident. We’re choosing caution over speed here.
